name: Drake Industrial Moisture-Wick Work Layer
description:
The cheapest functional base layer available in Meridian 88. A single-layer moisture-wicking shirt and legging set that pulls sweat away from the skin and dries within minutes. No smart features, no armor, no sensors — just dry comfort for people who work hard enough to need it.

Sold in packs of three at every supply depot and street market in the lower tiers. The Moisture-Wick Work Layer is the one garment that transcends social boundaries — everyone sweats, and this is the cheapest way to manage it.
what_it_says: You work and you sweat and you spent the minimum to stay dry while doing it.
story_hooks: A bulk shipment of Drake Work Layers destined for a Shelf factory is intercepted — not for the garments, but for something sewn into the linings that the manufacturer didn't put there.
